item.title: Pheditor Hardcoded Default Password to Remote Code Execution (CVE-2026-55579)
item.description: Critical severity (CVSS 9.8) — web · CVE-2026-55579 / GHSA-p4h7-p9rj-2pq2 / CWE-798. Status: Weaponized (complete end-to-end chain: default-password login, CSRF token scrape, terminal command execution, optional file upload; no capture of a successful run is published). Affects: Pheditor, a single-file PHP editor and file manager by Hamid Samak. Tags: pheditor, php, hardcoded-credentials, default-password, cwe-798, terminal, file-manager, rce, unauthenticated.
